name: create_animation
description: Creates a new animation with keyframes for bones.

animation_length.description: Length of the animation in seconds

particle_effects.description: Particle effects with timestamps as keys

name: manage_keyframes
description: Creates, deletes, or edits keyframes in the animation timeline for specific bones and channels.

animation_id.description: Animation UUID or name. If not provided, uses current animation.

bone_name.description: Name of the bone/group to manage keyframes for.

time.description: Time in seconds for the keyframe.

values.description: Values: [x,y,z] for position/rotation, number for uniform scale.

bezier_handles.description: Bezier handle positions for bezier interpolation.

name: animation_graph_editor
description: Controls animation curves in the graph editor for fine-tuning animations.

animation_id.description: Animation UUID or name. If not provided, uses current animation.

bone_name.description: Name of the bone/group to modify curves for.

action.description: Type of curve modification to apply.

keyframe_range.description: Time range to apply the curve modification. If not provided, applies to all keyframes.

custom_curve.description: Custom bezier curve control points (only for 'custom' action).

name: bone_rigging
description: Creates and manipulates the bone structure (rig) of a model for animation.

action.description: Action to perform on the bone structure.

children.description: Names of elements to add to this bone.

ik_enabled.description: Enable inverse kinematics for this bone.

mirror_axis.description: Axis to mirror the bone across.

name: animation_timeline
description: Controls the animation timeline, including playback, time scrubbing, and timeline settings.

length.description: Animation length in seconds (for set_length action).

name: batch_keyframe_operations
description: Performs batch operations on multiple keyframes at once.

scale_factor.description: Scale factor for time or values.

name: animation_copy_paste
description: Copies and pastes animation data between bones or animations.

time_range.description: Time range to copy. If not provided, copies all keyframes.

mirror_axis.description: Axis to mirror across for mirror_paste.

name: list_armatures
description: Lists all armatures in the current project with their basic info.

name: get_armature
description: Gets detailed information about a specific armature including its bones.

id.description: UUID or name of the armature.

include_bones.description: Whether to include bone hierarchy in response.

name: add_armature
description: Creates a new armature in the project. An armature is a skeletal rig used for mesh deformation.

add_initial_bone.description: Whether to add an initial bone to the armature.

name: remove_armature
description: Removes an armature and all its bones from the project.

id.description: UUID or name of the armature to remove.

name: update_armature
description: Updates properties of an existing armature.

id.description: UUID or name of the armature.

name: list_armature_bones
description: Lists all armature bones, optionally filtered by a specific armature.

armature_id.description: Filter bones by armature UUID or name. If not provided, lists all bones.

name: get_armature_bone
description: Gets detailed information about a specific armature bone.

id.description: UUID or name of the bone.

include_weights.description: Whether to include all vertex weights in response.

name: add_armature_bone
description: Creates a new bone and adds it to an armature or parent bone.

parent_id.description: UUID or name of parent armature or bone.

origin.description: Position of the bone. Defaults to [0, parent.length, 0] for child bones.

connected.description: Whether bone is connected to parent.

name: remove_armature_bone
description: Removes an armature bone from the project.

id.description: UUID or name of the bone to remove.

remove_children.description: Whether to also remove child bones.

name: update_armature_bone
description: Updates properties of an existing armature bone.

id.description: UUID or name of the bone.

rotation.description: New rotation [x, y, z] in degrees.

name: update_armature_bones_batch
description: Updates multiple armature bones at once with the same properties.

items.description: ID or name of the element.

ids.description: Array of bone UUIDs or names to update.

name: select_armature_bones
description: Selects armature bones by ID. Can select single bone, multiple bones, or bone hierarchy.

items.description: ID or name of the element.

ids.description: Array of bone UUIDs or names to select.

armature_id.description: Select all bones in this armature.

include_descendants.description: Include all descendant bones in selection.

name: get_vertex_weights
description: Gets vertex weights for a mesh from all bones affecting it.

mesh_id.description: ID or name of the mesh. If not provided, uses selected mesh.

name: set_vertex_weight
description: Sets the weight of a specific vertex on a bone.

bone_id.description: UUID or name of the bone.

mesh_id.description: ID or name of the mesh. If not provided, uses selected mesh.

vertex_key.description: Key of the vertex in the mesh.

weight.description: Weight value (0-1). Set to 0 to remove weight.

name: set_vertex_weights_batch
description: Sets multiple vertex weights at once on a bone.

bone_id.description: UUID or name of the bone.

mesh_id.description: ID or name of the mesh. If not provided, uses selected mesh.

name: clear_vertex_weights
description: Clears all vertex weights from a bone for a specific mesh.

bone_id.description: UUID or name of the bone.

mesh_id.description: ID or name of the mesh. If not provided, uses selected mesh.

name: capture_screenshot
description: Returns the image data of the current view.

name: capture_app_screenshot
description: Returns the image data of the Blockbench app.

name: set_camera_angle
description: Sets the camera angle to the specified value.

name: place_cube
description: Places a cube of the given size at the specified position. Texture and group are optional.

texture.description: Texture ID or name to apply to the cube.

group.description: Group/bone to which the cube belongs.

anyOf.description: Array of faces to apply the texture to.
Whether to apply the texture to all faces. Set to `true` to enable auto UV mapping.

face.description: Face to apply the texture to.

uv.description: Custom UV mapping for the face.

anyOf.description: Array of faces with custom UV mapping.

faces.description: Faces to apply the texture to. Set to `true` to enable auto UV mapping.

name: modify_cube
description: Modifies the cube with the given ID. Auto UV setting: saved as an integer, where 0 means disabled, 1 means enabled, and 2 means relative auto UV (cube position affects UV)

id.description: ID or name of the cube to modify. Defaults to selected, which could be more than one.

autouv.description: Auto UV setting. 0 = disabled, 1 = enabled, 2 = relative auto UV.

shade.description: Whether to apply shading to the cube.

color.description: Single digit to represent a color from a palette.

visibility.description: Whether the cube is visible or not.

name: remove_element
description: Removes the element with the given ID.

id.description: ID or name of the element to remove.

name: add_group
description: Adds a new group with the given name and options.

autouv.description: Auto UV setting. 0 = disabled, 1 = enabled, 2 = relative auto UV.

name: list_outline
description: Returns the project outline as a hierarchical tree. Each node reports { name, uuid, type (cube|mesh|group), children? }. Groups contain child cubes, meshes, and sub-groups. Use `include_cubes=false` to get a group-only skeleton when you just need structure, or `max_depth` to bound very deep trees.

include_cubes.description: If true, include cubes as leaves. If false, return groups only.

include_meshes.description: If true, include meshes as leaves. If false, omit meshes.

max_depth.description: Maximum tree depth to traverse. Use a small value to summarize large projects.

name: duplicate_element
description: Duplicates a cube, mesh or group by ID or name.  You may offset the duplicate or assign a new name.

id.description: ID or name of the element to duplicate.

name: rename_element
description: Renames a cube, mesh or group by ID or name.

id.description: ID or name of the element to rename.

name: find_elements_by_criteria
description: Searches the current project for elements matching the given criteria. Supports name pattern matching (regex or substring), type filtering, scoping to a parent group, cube size ranges, and selection scope. Returns element metadata, never modifies state.

name_pattern.description: Regex pattern to match element names (e.g., '^arm_.*'). Case-sensitive.

name_contains.description: Substring to match in element names. Case-insensitive.

type.description: Restrict to a single element type.

parent_group.description: UUID or name of a parent group. Only descendants of this group are returned.

min_size.description: Minimum [x,y,z] size for cubes. Cubes smaller on any axis are excluded.

max_size.description: Maximum [x,y,z] size for cubes. Cubes larger on any axis are excluded.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

name: select_all_of_type
description: Selects all elements of the given type (cube, mesh, or group) in the current project. Optionally restrict to descendants of a parent group, or add to (rather than replace) the current selection.

add_to_selection.description: If true, add to current selection. If false, replace selection.

parent_group.description: UUID or name of a parent group. If provided, only descendants of this group are selected.

name: filter_by_material
description: Returns all elements that reference the given texture. For cubes, includes the list of face keys (e.g., 'north', 'up') that use the texture. For meshes, returns the mesh if any face uses the texture.

texture.description: Texture ID, UUID or name to search for.

include_face_keys.description: Include the list of cube face keys (e.g., 'north') that reference the texture.

name: get_selection
description: Returns the current selection state: selected cube/mesh/group UUIDs and names, plus the active texture. Use this to verify what `apply_texture` or a paint tool with `fill_mode="selected_elements"` will target.

name: list_export_formats
description: Lists all registered export codecs with their id, display name, file extension, and whether they support compile/export. Use before `export_model` to pick a codec.

only_current_format.description: If true, only return codecs compatible with the current project's format.

name: export_model
description: Compiles the current project through the named codec and returns the result as text. Optionally writes the compiled content to a filesystem path (requires user permission in Blockbench v5.0+). Use `list_export_formats` first to discover codec IDs.

codec_id.description: Codec ID to use for export (e.g., 'obj', 'gltf', 'project', 'bedrock'). If omitted, uses the current project format's codec. Use `list_export_formats` to see available IDs.

options.description: Codec-specific export options. Defaults to the codec's configured export options.

path.description: Absolute filesystem path to write the compiled model to. Requires user permission (Blockbench v5.0+ prompts for 'fs' access). If omitted, content is returned in the response only.

max_content_length.description: Maximum number of characters to include in the returned `content` field. Use 0 to omit content entirely (useful when only writing to disk). Larger values risk exceeding MCP context limits.

name: undo
description: Undoes the most recent edit in the current project. Use `steps` to undo multiple edits in a single call. Returns the action(s) that were undone.

name: redo
description: Redoes the most recently undone edit. Use `steps` to redo multiple edits in a single call. Returns the action(s) that were redone.

name: get_undo_stack
description: Returns the current undo/redo history: the list of edit entries, the current index, and which entries are undone vs. applied. Use this to inspect available undo/redo operations and find named checkpoints.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (most recent first).

name: save_checkpoint
description: Inserts a named marker into the undo history. The marker can later be located with `get_undo_stack` so the agent knows how many times to call `undo` to return to this state. Does not modify the project.

name.description: Descriptive name for the checkpoint. Shown in undo history so agents can navigate back to this point.

name: from_geo_json
description: Imports a model from a GeoJSON file.

geojson.description: Path to the GeoJSON file or data URL, or the GeoJSON string itself.

name: get_face_material_instances
description: Gets the material instance names for cube faces. Material instances are used in Bedrock Block format to map faces to materials defined in the minecraft:material_instances component.

cube_id.description: ID or name of the cube. If not provided, uses the first selected cube.

faces.description: Specific faces to get/clear material instances for. If not provided, returns/clears all faces.

name: set_face_material_instance
description: Sets the material instance name for one or more cube faces. Material instances are strings that map to materials defined in the minecraft:material_instances component for Bedrock Block format.

cube_id.description: ID or name of the cube. If not provided, applies to all selected cubes.

material_name.description: The material instance name to assign. Use empty string to clear the material instance.

faces.description: Faces to set the material instance on. Defaults to all faces.

name: list_material_instances
description: Lists all unique material instance names used in the project. Returns the material instance names along with which cubes and faces use them.

name: bulk_set_material_instances
description: Sets material instance names on multiple cubes at once. Useful for assigning different material instances to different faces across the project.

cube_id.description: ID or name of the cube.

faces.description: Faces to set the material instance on.

name: clear_material_instances
description: Clears (removes) material instance names from cube faces. Useful for resetting material assignments.

cube_id.description: ID or name of the cube. If not provided, clears from all selected cubes.

faces.description: Specific faces to clear. If not provided, clears all faces.

all_cubes.description: If true, clears material instances from all cubes in the project.

name: place_mesh
description: Places a mesh at the specified position. Texture and group are optional.

texture.description: Texture ID or name to apply to the mesh.

group.description: Group/bone to which the mesh belongs.

name: extrude_mesh
description: Extrudes selected faces or edges of a mesh.

mesh_id.description: ID or name of the mesh. If not provided, uses selected mesh.

mode.description: What to extrude: faces, edges, or vertices.

name: subdivide_mesh
description: Subdivides selected faces of a mesh to create more geometry.

mesh_id.description: ID or name of the mesh. If not provided, uses selected mesh.

cuts.description: Number of subdivision cuts to make.

name: create_sphere
description: Creates a sphere mesh at the specified position with the given parameters. The sphere is created as a mesh with vertices and faces using spherical coordinates.

sides.description: Number of horizontal divisions (affects sphere quality).

align_edges.description: Whether to align edges for better geometry.

texture.description: Texture ID or name to apply to the sphere.

group.description: Group/bone to which the sphere belongs.

name: select_mesh_elements
description: Selects vertices, edges, or faces of a mesh for manipulation.

mesh_id.description: ID or name of the mesh to select elements from.

elements.description: Specific elements to select. If not provided, selects all.

action.description: Selection action: select (replace), add, remove, or toggle.

name: move_mesh_vertices
description: Moves selected vertices of a mesh by the specified offset.

mesh_id.description: ID or name of the mesh. If not provided, uses selected mesh.

offset.description: Offset to move vertices by [x, y, z].

vertices.description: Specific vertex keys to move. If not provided, moves all selected vertices.

name: delete_mesh_elements
description: Deletes selected vertices, edges, or faces from a mesh.

mesh_id.description: ID or name of the mesh. If not provided, uses selected mesh.

mode.description: What to delete: vertices, edges, or faces.

keep_vertices.description: When deleting faces/edges, whether to keep the vertices.

name: merge_mesh_vertices
description: Merges vertices that are within a specified distance of each other.

mesh_id.description: ID or name of the mesh.

threshold.description: Maximum distance between vertices to merge.

selected_only.description: Whether to only merge selected vertices.

name: create_mesh_face
description: Creates a new face from selected vertices.

mesh_id.description: ID or name of the mesh. If not provided, uses selected mesh.

vertices.description: Vertex keys to create face from. Must be 3 or 4 vertices.

texture.description: Texture ID or name to apply to the new face.

name: create_cylinder
description: Creates one or more cylinder meshes with optional end caps.

texture.description: Texture ID or name. If not provided, uses selected texture.

name: knife_tool
description: Uses the knife tool to cut custom edges into mesh faces.

mesh_id.description: ID or name of the mesh to cut.

face.description: Face key to attach the point to.

name: paint_fill_tool
description: Uses the fill/bucket tool to fill areas with color.

texture_id.description: Texture ID or name. If not provided, uses selected texture.

name: draw_shape_tool
description: Draws geometric shapes on textures.

texture_id.description: Texture ID or name. If not provided, uses selected texture.

shape.description: Shape to draw. '_h' suffix means hollow.

name: gradient_tool
description: Applies gradients to textures.

texture_id.description: Texture ID or name. If not provided, uses selected texture.

name: color_picker_tool
description: Picks colors from textures and sets them as the active color.

texture_id.description: Texture ID or name. If not provided, uses selected texture.

x.description: X coordinate to pick color from.

y.description: Y coordinate to pick color from.

set_as_secondary.description: Set as secondary color instead of primary.

pick_opacity.description: Also pick and apply the pixel's opacity.

name: copy_brush_tool
description: Uses the copy/clone brush to copy texture areas.

texture_id.description: Texture ID or name. If not provided, uses selected texture.

x.description: Source X coordinate to copy from.

y.description: Source Y coordinate to copy from.

x.description: Target X coordinate to paste to.

y.description: Target Y coordinate to paste to.

name: eraser_tool
description: Erases parts of textures with customizable settings.

texture_id.description: Texture ID or name. If not provided, uses selected texture.

coordinates.description: Array of coordinates to erase at.

connect_strokes.description: Whether to connect erase strokes with lines.

name: paint_settings
description: Configures paint mode settings and preferences.

x.description: X coordinate of texture mirror center.

y.description: Y coordinate of texture mirror center.

paint_side_restrict.description: Restrict painting to current face side.

paint_with_stylus_only.description: Only allow painting with stylus input.

pick_color_opacity.description: Pick opacity when using color picker.

name: paint_with_brush
description: Paints on textures using the brush tool with customizable settings.

texture_id.description: Texture ID or name. If not provided, uses selected texture.

coordinates.description: Array of coordinates to paint at.

connect_strokes.description: Whether to connect paint strokes with lines.

name: create_brush_preset
description: Creates a custom brush preset with specified settings.

name: load_brush_preset
description: Loads and applies a brush preset by name.

preset_name.description: Name of the brush preset to load.

name: texture_selection
description: Creates, modifies, or manipulates texture selections for painting.

texture_id.description: Texture ID or name. If not provided, uses selected texture.

name: texture_layer_management
description: Creates, manages, and manipulates texture layers.

texture_id.description: Texture ID or name. If not provided, uses selected texture.

name: create_project
description: Creates a new project with the given name and project type.

format.description: Project format ID from Blockbench's Formats registry.

name: get_project_info
description: Returns read-only project orientation: format id and display name, project name/UUID, texture resolution (texture_width/height), element counts, and a summary of top-level groups. Prefer this over `risky_eval` for first-look inspection — no JavaScript execution required.

name: create_texture
description: Creates a new texture with the given name and size.

data.description: Path to the image file or data URL.

fill_color.description: RGBA color to fill the texture, as tuple or HEX string.

layer_name.description: Name of the texture layer. Required if fill_color is set.

pbr_channel.description: PBR channel to use for the texture. Color, normal, height, or Metalness/Emissive/Roughness (MER) map.

render_mode.description: Render mode for the texture. Default, emissive, additive, or layered.

render_sides.description: Render sides for the texture. Auto, front, or double.

name: apply_texture
description: Applies the given texture to the element with the specified ID.

id.description: ID or name of the element to apply the texture to.

texture.description: ID or name of the texture to apply.

applyTo.description: Apply texture to element or group.

name: add_texture_group
description: Adds a new texture group with the given name.

textures.description: Array of texture IDs or names to add to the group.

is_material.description: Whether the texture group is a PBR material or not.

name: list_textures
description: Returns a list of all textures in the Blockbench editor.

name: get_texture
description: Returns the image data of the given texture or default texture.

texture.description: Texture ID or name. If not provided, uses selected texture.

name: create_pbr_material
description: Creates a new PBR material (texture group with is_material=true) and optionally assigns textures to PBR channels. Use this for Minecraft Bedrock resource packs or any format supporting PBR.

color_texture.description: Texture ID/name for the color (albedo) channel.

normal_texture.description: Texture ID/name for the normal map channel.

height_texture.description: Texture ID/name for the height/displacement map channel.

mer_texture.description: Texture ID/name for the MER (Metalness/Emissive/Roughness) channel.

color_value.description: Uniform RGBA color [R,G,B,A] when no color texture is provided.

mer_value.description: Uniform MER values [Metalness, Emissive, Roughness] (0-255) when no MER texture is provided.

subsurface_value.description: Subsurface scattering value (0-255) for Bedrock 1.21.30+ materials.

name: configure_material
description: Configures an existing PBR material's properties including channel assignments, uniform values, and subsurface scattering.

material.description: Material name or UUID to configure.

color_texture.description: Texture ID/name for the color channel, or 'none' to use uniform color.

normal_texture.description: Texture ID/name for the normal map, or 'none' to remove.

height_texture.description: Texture ID/name for the height map, or 'none' to remove.

mer_texture.description: Texture ID/name for MER channel, or 'none' to use uniform values.

color_value.description: Uniform RGBA color [R,G,B,A] when no color texture.

name: list_materials
description: Lists all PBR materials (texture groups with is_material=true) and their assigned textures per channel.

name: get_material_info
description: Gets detailed information about a PBR material including the compiled texture_set.json preview for Bedrock export.

name: import_texture_set
description: Imports a Minecraft Bedrock texture_set.json file and creates a PBR material with the associated textures.

path.description: Path to the .texture_set.json file to import.

name: assign_texture_channel
description: Assigns a texture to a specific PBR channel within a material.

texture.description: Texture name or UUID to assign.

channel.description: PBR channel to assign the texture to.

name: save_material_config
description: Saves the material's texture_set.json file to disk (Bedrock format). Requires the color texture to have a valid file path.

material.description: Material name or UUID to save.

name: activate_texture
description: Activates the given texture in the Blockbench texture panel so that subsequent paint operations (draw_shape_tool, paint_with_brush, gradient_tool, etc.) target it. Most paint tools already call this internally when a texture_id is provided, but you can invoke it explicitly to pin the active texture across multiple calls.

texture.description: Texture ID, UUID, or name to activate in the texture panel.

name: trigger_action
description: Triggers an action in the Blockbench editor.

action.description: Action ID from Blockbench's BarItems registry.

confirmDialog.description: Whether or not to automatically confirm any dialogs that appear as a result of the action.

name: risky_eval
description: Evaluates the given expression and logs it to the console. Do not pass `console` commands as they will not work.

code.description: JavaScript code to evaluate. Do not pass `console` commands or comments.

name: emulate_clicks
description: Emulates clicks on the given interface elements.

duration.description: Duration of the drag in milliseconds.

drag.description: Drag options. If set, will perform a drag from position to 'to'.

name: fill_dialog
description: Fills the dialog with the given values.

values.description: Stringified form of values to fill the dialog with.

confirm.description: Whether to confirm or cancel the dialog after filling it. True to confirm, false to cancel.

name: set_mesh_uv
description: Sets UV coordinates for mesh faces or vertices.

mesh_id.description: ID or name of the mesh.

face_key.description: Face key to set UV for.

uv_mapping.description: UV coordinates for each vertex of the face.

name: auto_uv_mesh
description: Automatically generates UV mapping for selected mesh faces.

mesh_id.description: ID or name of the mesh. If not provided, uses selected mesh.

mode.description: UV mapping mode: project from view, unwrap, cylinder, or sphere mapping.

faces.description: Specific face keys to UV map. If not provided, maps all selected faces.

name: rotate_mesh_uv
description: Rotates UV coordinates of selected mesh faces.

mesh_id.description: ID or name of the mesh. If not provided, uses selected mesh.

faces.description: Specific face keys to rotate UV for. If not provided, rotates all selected faces.
